title: Juggernaut
description: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
smart_description: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
notes: Triggers whenever the holder gains Block. The power increments its Counter stack type, allowing tracking of how many times Block was gained during combat.
